On the other hand, Cobanza, who complained constantly but flattered his superiors and smoothly advanced his career after getting in through connections. Although they took the same exam, they led completely different lives, yet they were assigned to the same unit for the contaminated water wave countermeasures. "This is going to be a turbulent ride... wave pun intended," thought Skez Hunter.  (DMRP-07)

Due to its ancient existence, it has no abilities and possesses a form devoid of excess. There is a theory that from this state, it undergoes various training to become a golem with abilities. Incidentally, the modern term 'simple', used to describe something without excess, is said to have originated from this Shinburu." —Chesize Bookshop 『Birth of Golem』 (DMRP-07)

Yes, this time they want to destroy everything. —Legend of the Onifuda Kingdom (DMEX-14)

[Shield Trigger]

Savark and Still Justice Till The End faced off against Emperor Aqutasha. However, Aqutasha attempted to crush them with twelve Mecha Del Sol units, each installed with an updated version of the 12 Programs. It was a desperate crisis...but just then, the newly succeeded Return of the Twelves arrived to aid them! (DMRP-20)

As Canbello resonated with Redzone’s soul and touched Momokingdam X's body, it was freed from inversion. Now fully restored, Momokingdom X unleashed the "Infinite X-Slash" upon Vol-Val-8! (DMRP-20)

Momoking was bewildered by the sudden question, but as he turned around, Mikadeoleo was standing there! (DMRP-20)

Flavor: シデンシーザーと対峙したゲンムエンペラーとテ・ラ・スザークだが、交互に繰り出される超銀河弾 HELLと超銀河剣 THE FINALの圧倒的なパワーを前に太刀打ちできない。それに対し、これこそ真の強者と認めたゲンムエンペラーは夢幻の無を乱射するが、超銀河兵器によって生み出された次元の裂け目にすべてかき消され、2人の身に超銀河弾が迫る! Genmu Emperor and Te Ra Szark faced off against Shidencaesar, but they were completely overwhelmed by the alternating assaults of Galaxy Shot - HELL and Galaxy Blade - THE FINAL. Recognizing Shidencaesar as a true powerhouse, Genmu Emperor unleashed a barrage of Daydream Dark Matter, yet every shot was swallowed by the dimensional rifts created by the Galaxy Weapons. With no way to counter, the Galaxy closed in on them! (DMRP-20)

Antoma Tan Gendo announces. "It's no use. I've already taken away the power of the 'The King of Legend'. All that's left of you is the powerless soul of the king, just an empty shell." (DMRP-20)

Then, Bolshack spoke. "Momoking! To counter him, you have no choice but to borrow the power of 'Hall Fame King', Bolbalzak!!" In the next moment, Momoking's consciousness was transported to an unfamiliar space. (DMRP-20)

Realizing that an immense amount of energy was needed to interrupt Black Bigbang's collision, Gigandydanos and Baraghiara decided to counter it by colliding with each other! Then, they plunged straight into Black Bigbang's impact!! Yes—their plan was to cancel out annihilation by annihilating annihilation itself, thus nullifying the effect of total erasure! (DMRP-20)

Mikadeoleo's Original Finale is a technique that implants four divine crests onto the bodies of those who oppose "me" once they enter its range, delivering divine judgment upon them. This unavoidable decree, ignoring all causality, strikes Momokingdam X—judgment has been passed! (DMRP-20)

name_ja: 火炎幻竜星弾

Flavor: ザ＝デッドNEXTと対峙したダイナボルト。だが、ザ＝デッドNEXTは戦う様子を見せず、ただ遠くに霞んで見える崩れたフライパン山を指差すと、その方向へ走りだす。一瞬いぶかしむダイナボルトだったが、すぐにその真意を察することができた。どちらが先にあそこまで着くか、レースで決着を付けようとしているのだと。Dynabolt stood face to face with The=DeadNEXT. However, instead of taking a battle stance, The=DeadNEXT simply pointed toward the distant, crumbling Frypan Mountain before dashing off in that direction. For a moment, Dynabolt was puzzled—but then, it all became clear. This wasn’t about a fight. It was a race to the finish. (DMRP-20)

name_ja: 寅年の演上者 プージョ
abilities_en: Flavor: ついに超獣王来烈伝に12の王の魂を収めたと思いきや、それは実はディスペクターを生み出していた黒幕、龍魂珠の思惑通りだった！ 「新世界」に適応できないすべての生命を死滅させるべく復活した五龍神から生み出された最悪のディスペクター、ヴォルゼオス・バラモルドを止めるべく、モモキングも未来王龍 モモキングJOへと覚醒！ 死闘の果てに、モモキングJOとヴォルゼオス・バラモルドの戦いがついに決着する！ はたしてボルメテウスは当たるのか!? 次回、デュエル・マスターズ キング「さらば歴史（とも）よ！ 涙の大団円」お見逃しなく!!　"Just when it seemed that all 12 kings' souls had been sealed within The King of Legend, it was all according to the true mastermind’s plan—the Dragon Soul Orb, the very force behind the creation of the Dispectors! To exterminate all life unable to adapt to the 'New World'. the five revived Dragon Gods gave rise to the ultimate Dispector: Volzeos Balamord. To stop this catastrophe, Momoking awakened into Momoking JO! After a fierce, desperate battle, the final clash between Momoking JO and Volzeos Balamord is about to be settled! Will Bolmeteus land its decisive blow!? Next time on Duel Masters King: 'Farewell, History (Comrades)! The Tearful Grand Finale'—Don’t miss it!!" ―Peugeot, Theater Star (DMRP-20)

name_ja: 機動 エルジ-1
abilities_ja:
■ このクリーチャーは、可能なら毎ターン、クリーチャーを攻撃する。

[Sasagale]

■ This creature attacks each turn if able.

[Sasagale]
Flavor: ブラック・ビッグバンは、周囲を巻き込みながら身体の上下が高速で入れ替わることで衝突と対消滅と復活を繰り返すディスペクターだった。このままではいずれ世界が消滅してしまうと感じたギガンディダノスは、衝突の瞬間に己の身体を割り込ませることで対消滅を防ごうとするも、莫大なエネルギーの奔流に阻まれ弾かれてしまう。だが、そこに乱入したのは自然文明の怒りの化身、バラギアラだった! Black Bigbang was a Dispector that constantly swapped its upper and lower halves at high speed, causing repeated collisions, annihilation, and resurrections—dragging everything around it into the cycle. Sensing that the world itself would eventually be erased at this rate, Gigandydanos attempted to interrupt the collisions by forcing its own body between them to halt the annihilation. However, the sheer torrent of energy overwhelmed and repelled it. But then—charging into the chaos—came the embodiment of Nature Civilization’s fury: Baraghiara! (DMRP-20)

name_ja: 星舞神 G・W・D
abilities_ja:

Flavor: オリジナルフィナーレを打ち破ったボルバル・モモキングは、ミカドレオに全力の一閃を食らわせる。歴史の裏側の力が込められた、必殺の一撃！それを受けたミカドレオの身体は動きを止め、「獅子王」ライオネルと「黒月王」神帝の魂は超獣王来烈伝へと還っていった。ついに12の王の魂すべてが揃ったのだ。Having shattered Original Finale, Bolbal Momoking unleashed a full-force slash at Mikadeoleo—a decisive strike infused with the power of history’s reverse side! Struck by the fatal blow, Mikadoleo's body froze in place, and the souls of "Lion King", Lionel and "Black Moon King", Emperor of the Gods returned to The King of Legend. At last, all 12 kings' souls had been gathered. (DMRP-20)

name_ja: ギーク戦車 ウサギアス

Flavor: ザ＝デッドNEXTを追いかけ、ダイナボルトもフライパン山に向けて走り出す。スタートの差があるとはいえ速度自慢のダイナボルトが圧勝するかと思いきや、ザ＝デッドNEXTは生み出されたばかりの肉体だというのにまるで何年も走り慣れているかのように速かった。このままでは勝てないかもしれない。だが自らの誇りでもある速さの勝負で絶対に負けたくはない……敗北への恐れから、ダイナボルトは強くそう思った。Chasing after The=DeadNEXT, Dynabolt also took off toward Frypan Mountain. Despite the initial head start, one would expect the speedster Dynabolt to claim an easy victory. However, The=DeadNEXT, despite having just been created, ran as if it had been racing for years, matching Dynabolt’s pace. At this rate, victory was uncertain. But Dynabolt, whose pride was built on speed, refused to lose in a race. A deep fear of defeat took hold—he couldn't afford to lose. (DMRP-20)

In a passing moment, with a flash of their wings, they completely pulverized Shidencaesar, into pieces, achieving a magnificent victory. (DMRP-20)

Black Bigbang, Sutured Phoenix, The=DeadNEXT, Electrofused DS, Emperor Aqutasha, Hybrid Invincible, Double Cross DD Zeta, Concatenated Awakened, and Galaxtest Shidencaesar, Connected Sengoku...these legendary Super Creatures, once central figures in historic turning-point battles, had now been transformed into Dispectors. (DMRP-20)

abilities_en:

abilities_ja:
■ ウラ・ニンジャ・ストライク2 (闇) (相手のクリーチャーが攻撃またはときじぶんまいいじょう やみぶんめいブロックした時、自分のマナゾーンのカードが2枚以上で闇文明があり、そのアタックちゅうつか攻撃中に「ニンジャ・ストライク」を使っていなければ、このシノビをコストをしはらしょうかんお支払わずに召喚してもよい。そのターンの終わりに、このシノビを山札の下おに置く)

■ このクリーチャーが出た時、このターン、自分のクリーチャー1体に「スレイヤー」を与 える。このターン、そのクリーチャーが破壊された時、自分はカードを2枚引く。 (「スレイ ヤー」を持つクリーチャーがバトルする時、バトルの後、相手クリーチャーを破壊する)
abilities_en:
■ Ura Ninja Strike 2 (Darkness) (Whenever one of your opponent's creatures attacks or blocks, if you have 2 or more cards in your mana zone and at least one of them is a darkness card and if during that attack you didn't use a "Ninja Strike" ability, you may summon this Shinobi for no cost. At the end of that turn, put this Shinobi on the bottom of your deck.) 

■ When you put this creature, one of your creatures gets "slayer" until the end of the turn. When that creature is destroyed this turn, draw 2 cards. (When a creature that has "slayer" battles, destroy your opponent's creature after the battle.)
